title: WeFair: Fidelity-Aware Alignment from Human Feedback for Personalized Query Rewriting in Short-Video Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.16927v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Short-video search requires compact query rewriters that infer personalized intent from brief, ambiguous queries under strict latency constraints. The challenge is to decide when personalization is warranted and generate a reformulation that preserves the user's immediate information need. A rewriter optimized for fluency or engagement may still introduce unsupported details and redirect the search toward a different intent. Existing methods often underutilize users' actual reformulations and behavioral traces, relying instead on synthetic reasoning and indirect behavioral rewards that may produce more engaging candidates but cause intent drift. To build an effective rewriter that remains faithful to user intent, we propose WeFair, Fidelity-Aware Alignment from Human Feedback for Personalized Query Rewriting in WeChat short-video search. WeFair assigns real user behavioral signals to a progression from demonstration to preference to veri

translated_title: WeFair：面向短视频搜索个性化查询改写的保真度感知人类反馈对齐
translated_abstract: 短视频搜索需要在严格延迟约束下，从简短、模糊的查询中推断个性化意图的紧凑查询改写器。其挑战在于判断何时有必要进行个性化，并生成能够保留用户当前信息需求的改写结果。一个为流畅性或用户参与度优化的改写器，仍可能引入无依据的细节，并将搜索引向不同的意图。现有方法往往未能充分利用用户实际的改写行为和行为痕迹，而是依赖合成推理和间接的行为奖励，这可能产生更具吸引力的候选结果，但会造成意图漂移。为了构建一个始终忠于用户意图的有效改写器，我们提出了WeFair——面向微信短视频搜索个性化查询改写的保真度感知人类反馈对齐方法。WeFair将真实用户行为信号分配到一个从示范到偏好再到验证的渐进式流程中
tldr: WeFair提出一种保真度感知的人类反馈对齐框架，利用真实用户行为信号按示范、偏好、验证三个阶段递进训练，使短视频搜索中的个性化查询改写器在满足严格延迟约束的同时忠于用户意图、避免意图漂移。
